facts.fact: The Shilak blockade order is written by the post commander and signed by the captain; Rohan signed it in the autumn before first snow, three winters running (ch 20).
Meera has an old burn-scar on her forearm; Rohan kisses it in ch 20.
When Meera begins to say a half-false claim aloud, her fingertips start to whiten; she stops before completing it, corrects herself, and the colour returns (ch 20).
The ash handprint is on the lintel of Nimmi's storehouse door as well as the house (ch 20).
